summary: Amphenol Corporation issued and sold €600 million of 3.375% Senior Notes due 2029 and €500 million of 3.875% Senior Notes due 2034 in an underwritten public offering under its existing shelf registration. The net proceeds of approximately €1.0931 billion will be used to repay commercial paper borrowings and a delayed draw term loan, with the remainder for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisory appointment, or event-driven structural terms are disclosed. The filing is a standard 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement for a note issuance.
